Alex M: Quick sync — CloudEdge + Orion joint announce is greenlit. We need a clear SI engagement and pipeline mapping plan.
Jess K: timeline?
Alex M: Target public week of May 6. Pre-announce to pilot customers by May 1. Main asks: lead ownership when listing in cloud marketplaces, demo account handoff, and co-sell credit rules.
Ben P: For marketplace leads, can we do: partner-intake -> SI qualify -> Redwood SDR touch -> assign to SI AE if partner qualifies? Suggest 72h SLA for assignment.
Priya S: 72h SLA sounds fine. Need rules for overlapping accounts (existing Redwood AE vs SI). Proposal: if Redwood has an active opportunity (CRM stage >= demo), Redwood retains ownership; otherwise SI gets primary and Redwood gets co-sell credit.
Tom L: +1. Also require the SI to log lead in our Partner Portal within 24h or it's considered unclaimed.
Jess K: Logging step: partners should submit CSV or use the portal API. Example mapping we expect:
```
account_name,account_id,primary_contact,email,origin,si_partner
Acme Corp,ACME-001,Sam Buyer,sam@acme.com,marketplace,OrionSI
```
Alex M: Good. Escalation flow: SI rep -> Partner Ops (Priya) -> Partnerships (Jess) -> Sales leadership. Add a cherrypick window: Redwood can request to retain a lead within 5 business days if strategic.
Ben P: We should also add demo ownership rules: SI runs initial tech demo, Redwood joins for architecture/scale questions. If SI cannot demo within 7 business days, Redwood can step in to avoid stall.
Priya S: Can we codify co-sell credit split? Simple starting point: revenue credit 60/40 for SI/Redwood on first-year ARR when SI sourced via partner-intake; revisit after quarter.
Tom L: Need a short-form one-pager for partners and SIs - I'll draft. Also action items for marketplace listing: link to listing -> map to partner ID -> webhook to Partner Portal for immediate intake.
partners-bot: checklist created: "si-joint-announce-1725123456" with items: listing, intake-webhook, claim-sla, demo-sla, credit-policy.
Jess K: Final ask — legal approval on co-sell terms. I'll ping legal and loop PMM for comms. Priya, can you own Partner Ops side of intake process + portal webhook testing?
Priya S: Yep, will own. I'll run webhook tests this week and send sample CSV schema.
Alex M: Thanks team. Tom - drop the one-pager in /docs/partners and tag this thread. We'll do a quick 20min sync Thurs to sign off.
Jess K: :thumbsup: 
Ben P: If anyone wants, sample escalation message to send to sales leadership:
"Heads up: potential joint pipeline from CloudEdge listing. SI: OrionSI. Estimated ARR: TBD. Please advise if we should retain."
Alex M: Perfect. Closing notes: keep intake lightweight, enforce SLAs, and publish the one-pager before May 1.
